name: qlrisk_price_treasury_bond
title: Price a TreasuryBond
description:
Price one Treasury Bond (qlrisk TreasuryBond): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), face_value (amount; default 100), coupon_pct* (percent, 3 = 3%), frequency (annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly/at maturity; default semi-annual), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, issuer, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "3Y", "face_value": 100, "coupon_pct": 3, "currency": "USD"} gives NPV 97.85 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
